expectations.text: The response does not invent company facts (revenue, users, market size) as if real
expectations.evidence: The file labels itself “骨架稿” and leaves facts as placeholders: “[已签约 X 家客户 / 月收入 X 万 / 环比增长 X%]” and “TAM `[ ]` / SAM `[ ]` / SOM `[ ]`”.

expectations.text: The response asks the user about purpose or context, or offers a planning step first
expectations.evidence: The transcript offers “先把结构和财务模型搭好，你把关键信息给我”; the file asks “做什么、给谁用、解决什么问题” and “现在到哪一步了：产品阶段 + 有没有收入/客户数”.
